sections.advice: Treat Food stop near Rakovník → Photo stop near Dobříš as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.
Photo stop near Dobříš → Near Modřany is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

Use High point near Sázava → Scenic stretch near Český Brod as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

scenicChapters.title: Jordan Kings Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 71 km this is Jordan Kings Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Baptism Site “Bethany Beyond the Jordan” → As-Salt - The Place of Tole
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 38 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-castrum-as-salt-the-place-of-tole.story: A 370 km round trip from Umm ar Raşāş - roughly 6 h 23 in the saddle. The stops in between: Baptism Site “Bethany Beyond the Jordan”, As-Salt - The Place of Tolerance and Urban, back through Baptism Site “Bethany Beyond the Jordan” and back through As-Salt - The Place of Tolerance and Urban. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
